fetched_title: Debate Helps Weak Judges Reward Stronger Models
summary: Tests proposer-critic debate with a stronger debater and weaker judge on verifiable code and logic tasks, finding debate helps only when the critic out-classifies the judge and that a single independent critique recovers most of the benefit. The design is correlational; full-text search found no randomized critique-validity manipulation, no mediation estimand and no all-wrong debate condition.
